In Geku, located in Arunachal Pradesh’s Upper Siang district, youth are opposing the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP), saying it threatens their ancestral land, livelihoods and identity. For these young protesters from the Adi community, the fight is not against development, but against a project they fear could transform their homeland without their voices being heard.
